The agent prices a $400,000 pair-off on Fri Dec 4 at 2:30 p.m. ET (before the 5:00 p.m. ET pair-off cutoff on the expiration date): if the live price is 100.750 (rates rose 25 bps) → `$400,000 × (100.750 − 101.250)/100 = −$2,000.00` → **cash back $2,000.00** to the partner (C2-1.1-04); if the live price is 101.750 → fee **$2,000.00**.

amendments.new_text: **Servicer identity in notices (Reg X §1024.35(c)/§1024.36(b) and comment 35(c)-2 exclusive address; Reg Z §1026.41(d)(6) contact information).** A servicer that designates an exclusive address for notices of error must designate the same address for information requests and must provide it in the designating notice, on every periodic statement or coupon book, on any servicing website and in every §1024.39/§1024.41 notice that carries contact information (it may also be included with a notice of transfer); the statement carries the servicer's toll-free number and, if applicable, an e-mail or web address;

amendments.section_heading: ### Verified requirement — Purchase the business day after certification
amendments.old_text: **Purchase the business day after certification; warehouse release effective by the purchase date (Selling Guide C2-2-04, C2-2-03; 29.4 `FNMA_C2_2_04_PURCHASE_EXPECTED_1BD`, `FNMA_C2_2_03_WAREHOUSE_RELEASE_BY_ACQUISITION_GATE`).** Whole loans are purchased "the business day following" certification; the warehouse lender's release (bailee terms, Form 2004A or the eNote Secured Party release) must be effective no later than the purchase date.
amendments.new_text: **Purchase after certification; warehouse release effective by the purchase date (Selling Guide C2-2-04, C2-2-03, both 05/04/2022, re-read 2026-09-15; 29.4 `FNMA_C2_2_04_PURCHASE_EXPECTED_1BD`, `FNMA_C2_2_03_WAREHOUSE_RELEASE_BY_ACQUISITION_GATE`).** Fannie Mae funds whole-loan purchase proceeds once clean delivery data is in Loan Delivery by 9:00 p.m. ET, the document custodian has the package by first-morning delivery the following day and has certified it; data or documents received after the cut-off are funded "on the business day following the date it receives these materials" — 29.4's certification-plus-one-business-day expectation is an operating reading of that sequence, not a quotation; any warehouse lender's interest "must be released no later than the date Fannie Mae acquires the note" (bailee-letter procedure C1-2-05, or the eNote Secured Party release).
amendments.rationale: C2-2-04's 'business day following' is the late-submission rule.
amendments.test_change: none (35.6-T10's expected_purchase_date 2026-11-17 stands as 29.4's expectation).
